# third_party

## Overview
Third-party libraries, IntelliJ plugin dependencies, and Dart VM service drivers.

## Subdirectories & Boundaries
- `intellij-plugins-dart`: Third-party IntelliJ Dart plugin sources and extensions.
- `lib`: Bundled third-party library dependencies.
- `vmServiceDrivers`: [./vmServiceDrivers/ABOUT.md](./vmServiceDrivers/ABOUT.md) - Java drivers and protocol elements for communicating with the Dart VM service.
